alarms.title: AI flags undercut that is not there
alarms.operator_message: The AI thinks there is undercut on the left edge. It is only medium sure.
alarms.technical_detail: Image classifier: undercut, confidence 0.58. Heatmap focuses on a bright reflection on the bead. The laser profile at the same spot shows no undercut (0.05 mm, limit 0.5 mm).

ai_decision.what: Possible undercut on the left edge, 40-55 mm from the start

ground_truth.root_cause: Glare from a shiny spot fooled the image model (false alarm).
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Good part sent to rework or scrap for no reason.

expected_response.resolved_when: Operator overrules the AI with a reason, or the part goes to manual inspection.

hints: The AI can be fooled by light reflections. Check before you act.
Look where the heatmap is red and compare with the bead profile at the same place.
If the profile and your eyes show no undercut, press 'AI was wrong' and accept the part.

alarms.literature: Image-based defect CNNs and Grad-CAM explanations: Zhang et al. 2026; Satsangi et al. 2026. Trust calibration: van der Waa et al. 2021.
resolution_script: Do not scrap the part yet.
Open the heatmap: the red spot is on a bright reflection.
Open the bead profile at the same place: depth 0.05 mm, limit 0.5 mm.
Look at the bead yourself. No undercut means the AI was wrong.
Press 'AI was wrong', choose 'reflection', and accept the part.
Press 'Problem solved' and write what you saw.

alarms.title: AI is unsure: unfamiliar material
alarms.operator_message: The AI says the bead is OK, but it has never seen this material before.
alarms.technical_detail: Bead classifier output OK with confidence 0.61 and an out-of-distribution warning: the input features fall outside the training range (zinc-coated surface, different bead appearance). Galvanised steel is prone to porosity from zinc vapour.

ground_truth.root_cause: Model trained only on plain steel; the bead has fine surface pores it cannot recognise.

hints: 'Unfamiliar' means the AI is guessing. Do not trust its OK.
This material was not in the examples the AI learned from.
Send the part to manual inspection and note that the material was new for the AI.

alarms.literature: Models fail when material or setup changes: Georgousis et al. 2026; Zhang et al. 2026 (generalisation).
resolution_script: Do not trust this 'OK': the AI has not seen this material.
Read the warning: galvanised steel was not in its examples.
Mark the weld 'Check needed' and send it to manual inspection.
Press 'AI unsure' so the team knows.
Press 'Problem solved' and write 'sent to inspection'.

alarms.title: AI missed internal pores (found by NDT)
alarms.operator_title: AI result and NDT do not match
alarms.operator_message: The AI said OK, but the X-ray found pores inside the weld. The AI was wrong.
alarms.technical_detail: Cross-check mismatch: bead classifier OK (0.91) from surface images and profile; radiographic test shows a porosity cluster below the surface. Surface sensors cannot see internal pores.

ground_truth.root_cause: Internal porosity; the AI only sees the surface.
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Weak weld delivered; AI keeps being trusted for defects it cannot see.

expected_response.resolved_when: Part quarantined and the AI miss recorded.

hints: The X-ray result counts, not the AI. The AI cannot look inside the weld.
Keep this part apart from good parts.
Press 'AI was wrong', put the part in quarantine and tell quality.

alarms.literature: Internal defects need radiographic/ultrasonic testing: Zhang et al. 2026; cross-check design: docs/04.
resolution_script: The X-ray result counts, not the AI. The AI only sees the surface.
Put the part in the red quarantine box.
Press 'AI was wrong' and choose 'internal pores'.
